review_candidates.title: Senior Software Test Automation Engineer
review_candidates.company: TATWEER MIDDLE EAST AND AFRICA L.L.C
review_candidates.description: Role Purpose The Senior Software Test Automation Engineer plays a key role in maintaining the quality and integrity of technology solutions delivered across Tatweer's Digital Transformation and Smart Technology portfolio. The position is responsible for establishing automated testing practices, enhancing software quality standards, and ensuring the successful deployment of scalable, secure, and high-performing applications that support enterprise, smart city, AI, and digital innovation initiatives. Key Responsibilities & Duties • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for web, mobile, and API applications. • Build and enhance test automation frameworks using industry-standard tools and best practices. • Execute functional, regression, integration, system, and end-to-end automated testing. • Develop automated test suites using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, and Appium. • Perform API testing and automation using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools. • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and delivery. • Identify, document, and track software defects while validating reported fixes. • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, DevOps Engineers, and QA teams throughout the development lifecycle. • Monitor test results, analyze quality metrics, and provide recommendations for continuous improvement. • Mentor junior QA and automation engineers and promote automation best practices across the team. Requirements • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. • 7+ years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation. • Strong experience with automation tools including Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver, and Appium. • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices. • Experience testing Web, Mobile, and API-based applications. • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar. • Strong knowledge of defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira and Azure DevOps. • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or LoadRunner is a plus. • Familiarity with programming languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Python, or C#.

review_candidates.title: Quality Center Center GSM Account B1+
review_candidates.description: Company Description Xceed is a leading multilingual Business Process Outsourcing provider in the EMEA region, with more than 10,000 web-enabled multichannel stations supporting clients in 10 different languages. The company operates sites in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, the UAE, and a new site in Saudi Arabia, serving government and commercial accounts across diverse sectors. Xceed delivers a wide range of services including inbound and outbound customer support, back office operations, infrastructure management, recruitment process outsourcing, helpdesk support, and social media analysis. The organization has received multiple international awards for outsourcing excellence, customer experience, sustainability, impact sourcing, and diversity, equity, and inclusion. Xceed maintains high operational standards supported by globally recognized certifications in business continuity, quality, occupational health and safety, environmental management, and information security. Role Description The Quality Center GSM Account B1+ role at Xceed is a full-time, on-site position based in Cairo. The role involves performing regular quality audits on customer interactions to ensure adherence to internal standards, client requirements, and regulatory guidelines. Daily tasks include monitoring calls or tickets, documenting findings, analyzing performance trends, and preparing clear reports and feedback for team leaders and agents. The role also supports continuous improvement initiatives by identifying root causes of quality gaps, recommending corrective actions, and collaborating with operations to implement best practices. In addition, the team member participates in calibration sessions, contributes to developing quality checklists and procedures, and helps maintain a consistent, high-quality customer experience across the GSM account. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to evaluate data, identify trends, and support performance improvement. Candidates should possess Quality Control and Quality Assurance skills to monitor interactions and ensure compliance with standards and procedures. Candidates should possess Quality Auditing skills to conduct structured reviews, document findings, and prepare accurate reports. Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to deliver clear feedback, collaborate with teams, and support alignment with client expectations. Relevant experience in contact center or BPO environments, especially telecom or GSM accounts, is highly beneficial. Proficiency in English at B1+ level or higher, with solid documentation and reporting abilities. Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment. Familiarity with quality frameworks, KPIs, and customer experience metrics; COPC or ISO-related exposure is a plus. Diploma or bachelor’s degree in business, communications, or a related field is preferred.

review_candidates.title: Senior Contracts Administrator - Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose: Liaise with Internal & External stakeholders in contracts management, contract compliance and contract issues to ensure proper contracts preparation, review and administration during the various stages of the construction process. Roles & Responsibilities: • Analyze the monthly reports, review findings and implement changes. • Ensure contracts compliance with contractual terms and conditions and highlight any gaps. • Quantify variation orders in terms of cost and time, and highlight key figures to be communicated accordingly with the management. • Revise the performing of claims quantification procedures: Delay + Loss of productivity as per the related policies. • Revise claims administration procedures and produce analysis and negotiation as guided and within approvals. • Revise legally binding Letter of Intents, Memorandums of Understanding, Contracts and Change Orders, post contract administration in settling disputes, interpreting contract terms, issue of Change Orders, and settlements of claims. • Follow up on problems which demand management attention, to ensure timely response to the client. • Maintain all related records, documentation and adequate filing system. • Respond to related document requests and various enquiries on daily basis. • Ensure that employee is working according to the company HSE policies and regulations, and fully aware of his job risk assessment and environmental aspects. Minimum Qualifications & Requirtment: Education/ Qualifications: Bachelor of Engineering (Arch./ Civil) Professional Certification: Contracts related Certificates (preferable) Work Experience: 5-7 years of experience in a related field Language: Very Good command of English language Computer Skills: Microsoft Office
